title: Vanilla & More
description: This modpack adds optimizations, additional vanilla-like content, general improvements, and well audiovisual enhancements such as animations, particles, Resource packs, and Shader Packs, and ambient sounds.
body:
# Vanilla & More
The **_Vanilla and More_** modpack contains additional features that fit in with Vanilla, Quality of Life improvements, general technical improvements, optimization mods, audiovisual enhancements, resource packs, and shader packs.

## Mods

### Content Mods:
- Better Archeology
- Katters Structures
- Structures
- Towns and Towers

### QOL: 
- Death Finder
- BetterF3
- Hunger Remover (Food Heals Health)
- Graves
- FallingTree
- Xaero's World Map/Minimap
- Inventory Profiles Next

### Visual:
- 3D Skin Layers
- Ambient Environment
- Continuity
- Falling Leaves
- Not Enough Animations
- Particular Reforged
- Visual Workbench
- Visuality
- Windy
- Lawrence's Ambient Fireflies

### Audio:
- AmbientSounds
- Cool Rain
- Presence Footsteps
- Sounds

**And Various Optimization Mods**

## Resource Packs 
### (Disble some or all if perfomance is bad):
- Cubic Sun & Moon
- Fresh Animations + Extensions:
  - [https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations)
  - [https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations-extensions](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations-extensions)
- Plump Plants
- Recolourful Containers
- Simple Grass Flowers
- Vanilla Mashup (PBR + Parallax Required)
- SPBR Extensions - Block Emission, Glowing Ore, Grass Parallax (PBR + Parallax Required)

### Shaders Included (Enable if your hardware can handle it):
1. Photon (Less Demanding)
2. Rethinking Voxels (More Demanding)
## Other Information:
Config and Options Files are included for recommended config/options. Feel free to change any config/options to fit your preferences and fine-tune performance.

This modpack is in beta, meaning the content is subject to change and expect more to be added based on feedback and what I think of.
